question: In which of the following places is the Tak Tok festival celebrated?
solution:
Correct **Ladakh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Tak Tok" or "Taktok"** which is a **Buddhist festival** celebrated in the **Taktok village of Ladakh, India**.
 
• The **festival **is usually held in the **month of July or August** and is celebrated by the **villagers** and **monks** who perform **traditional dances,** **chants**, and **prayers.**
